criteria_table.title: Deficit-Step Error Reduction (>70%)
criteria_table.requirement: Memory model achieves > 70% error reduction on information-deficit transition steps (Delta E > 0).
criteria_table.notes: Under capacity-matched control and early stopping, error reduction is 19.05%. Did not reach 70% bar.

criteria_table.title: Strict Held-Out Superiority
criteria_table.requirement: Memory model outperforms no-memory baselines on strictly held-out trajectories.
criteria_table.notes: Memory advantage survives capacity matching and early stopping.

criteria_table.title: 8-Seed Reproducibility
criteria_table.requirement: Results are reproducible across 8 independent random seeds with consistent superiority.
criteria_table.status_after_e007: Not re-tested across 8 seeds in E007
criteria_table.notes: Corrected win rate is 7/8. Consistent superiority=False.

criteria_table.title: Temporal Retention Horizon (d in [0, 8])
criteria_table.requirement: Memory model evaluates advantage across delays d in [0, 1, 2, 4, 8].
criteria_table.original_result: Evaluated; advantage grew with delay d >= 1 (PASS)
criteria_table.status_after_e007: Zero-shot transfer evaluated; d=0 anomaly isolated
criteria_table.status_after_e008: Canonical per-delay sweep evaluated against capacity-matched baseline (PASS)
criteria_table.notes: Memory advantage maintained across all delays d in {1, 2, 4, 8}.

criteria_table.title: Unseen Delay Generalization (d in {3, 6})
criteria_table.requirement: Memory model generalizes to out-of-distribution unseen delays d=3 (interpolation) and d=6 (extrapolation).
criteria_table.original_result: Failed at both d=3 and d=6 (FAIL)
criteria_table.status_after_e007: Zero-shot transfer passed with early stopping (PASS/UNRECONCILED)
criteria_table.status_after_e008: Canonical pooled training with early stopping passed at d=3 and d=6 (PASS)
criteria_table.notes: Canonical pooled training with early stopping yields d=3 beats persistence: True, d=6 beats persistence: True.

criteria_table.title: Episode Boundary Memory Isolation
criteria_table.requirement: Strict episode boundary memory isolation (zero cross-episode state contamination).
criteria_table.notes: State buffers and hidden activations clear 100% on reset.

criteria_table.title: Semantic Firewall Zero-Leakage Compliance
criteria_table.requirement: Zero forbidden semantic tokens in observations, containers, or serialization.

phase3_status.remediation_guidance: Criteria failing or partially met: Deficit-Step Error Reduction (>70%), 8-Seed Reproducibility.
